tracedAction: Represents the grievance and community feedback mechanism for complaints, claims and beneficiary concerns. Gives affected people a route to raise implementation problems, beneficiary concerns and complaints.
tracedActionAr: تمثّل آلية الشكاوى وملاحظات المجتمع المحلي الخاصة بالشكاوى والمطالبات وهواجس المستفيدين. وتتيح للمتضرّرين مساراً لطرح مشكلات التنفيذ وهواجس المستفيدين والشكاوى.
summary: Represents the grievance and community feedback mechanism for complaints, claims and beneficiary concerns. Gives affected people a route to raise implementation problems, beneficiary concerns and complaints.
